name: wirebench
description: Build and verify isolated circuit drafts in the running WireBench desktop app. Pair in WireBench and accept finished work there.

url.title: WireBench MCP URL
url.description: The http://127.0.0.1:PORT/mcp URL shown in WireBench Assistant → External assistants.

token.title: WireBench pairing token
token.description: The token shown once after Pair client. This is a local pairing token, not a model API key.
